description: This file is a CMake script containing macro and function definitions for managing build configurations, target properties, dependencies, and installation procedures. It includes utility functions for handling library names, link libraries, compile definitions, include directories, and packaging configurations for larger CMake-based projects.

methods.name: add_element
methods.description: Appends an element to a specified list variable in CMake.

methods.name: _get_default_link_name
methods.description: Extracts the base name and directory from a library path, handling naming conventions such as 'lib' prefixes and file extensions.

methods.name: get_if_link_libraries
methods.description: Retrieves the link libraries and directories for a given target, handling imported and local targets, and recursively including interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_defines
methods.description: Gathers all compile definitions (preprocessor flags) associated with a target, including dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_options
methods.description: Collects compile options (flags) for a target, including inherited options through dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_include_dirs
methods.description: Retrieves include directories for a target and its dependencies, resolving relative paths and avoiding build interface directories.

methods.name: InstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a CMake configuration file (.cmake) for a target, including handling dependencies and versioning.

methods.name: InstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Creates and installs a pkg-config (.pc) file for a package, including compile options, definitions, include dirs, and link flags.

methods.name: InstallFindModule
methods.description: Installs CMake find modules (.cmake) from specified directories or files, with support for recursive globbing.

methods.name: print_properties
methods.description: Prints a list of CMake property names.

methods.name: print_target_properties
methods.description: Displays all supported properties for a specific CMake target.

methods.name: semicolon_safe_string
methods.description: Replaces semicolons in a string with a safe placeholder (ASCII 31) to avoid issues in CMake lists.

methods.name: InstallCompatibleCMakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a legacy compatible CMake interface target and installs its configuration for backward compatibility.
